layers.name: User Interface
layers.description: Reusable UI components and layout structures for the frontend application.

layers.name: API Endpoints
layers.description: HTTP request handlers for managing data exchange between frontend and backend systems.

layers.name: Frontend Data
layers.description: Data-related logic and utilities for frontend features like page help functionality.

layers.name: Configuration
layers.description: Application settings and environment-specific configurations for deployment.

layers.name: Service Modules
layers.description: Backend business logic and utility functions for processing data and coordinating application workflows.

layers.name: Utility Helpers
layers.description: Provides reusable functions for common tasks like API interactions, error handling, and styling utilities.

layers.name: Core Application Logic
layers.description: Contains main business logic for data management, security, and integration with external services like email and AI.

layers.name: Data Migration & Testing Tools
layers.description: Includes scripts for testing scenarios, data migration, and system setup tasks like seeding test data.
